evidence_excerpts: An ANOVA for the RT difference scores of the orienting component revealed a significant factor of group [F(2,48) = 10.13, p < .001]. A series of contrasts revealed that the MBSR group differed from the control group and the retreat group.
text: An 8-week mindfulness-based stress reduction course improves endogenous orienting relative to control and retreat groups at post-training testing.
